API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIData Loss PreventionICAP Server Resource Get ICAP Servers
ICAP Server Resource Get ICAP Servers
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/icapServers

Gets a the list of DLP servers using ICAP. To learn more, see About ICAP Communication Between Zscaler and DLP Servers, Enabling Secure ICAP, and Enabling Unencrypted ICAP.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

The unique identifier for a DLP server.

name
string
REQUIRED

The DLP server name.

url
string
REQUIRED

The DLP server URL.

status
string
REQUIRED

The DLP server status

Possible values: [ENABLED, DISABLED]

]
